title: Patron's Guide: Amending a Live Contract Under Grain Marketing Contracts
content:
**What may an amendment change?** A live contract under Grain Marketing Contracts may be amended in writing to change the bushels committed, to move the last day of the delivery window inside the programme's extension allowance, or to change the facility the grain is called to.

**By when must it be registered?** An amendment is signed and registered no later than the amendment window running from the day the contract was countersigned. The amendment window is counted in whole calendar days from the activation date, the activation date itself counting as day zero, and an amendment registered on the final day of the window is still in time. The activation date, the contract number and the count of amendments already taken are read off the contract record.

*On the boundary.* Where the programme's amendment window is 14 calendar days, an amendment registered on the fourteenth day after the day of countersigning, that day counting as day zero, is in time; one registered on the fifteenth day is out of time.

**What standing must the contract be in?** An amendment is taken only while the contract stands in active or delivering, read off the contract record against the contract number.

**How many, and at what cost?** A contract may take no more amendments than the programme's ceiling, and each one carries the programme's amendment fee, charged whether or not the amendment later proves unnecessary.

**What is not an amendment?** Moving the delivery window out beyond the extension allowance is not an amendment at all but a roll, and lowering bushels below what has already been delivered is refused outright.

**What where the ceiling is used up?** Where a member wants a change the programme's amendment ceiling no longer allows, the contract is bought out and rewritten, and the buyout charge applies in the ordinary way.

## Conditions in one view

| Condition | What settles it | Boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Inside the amendment window | the day the contract was countersigned, on the contract record | the final day of the window is still in time |
| Contract live | the contract record shows active or delivering | neither applied nor any terminal standing qualifies |
| Ceiling not used up | the count of amendments on the contract record | the programme's ceiling is the last one taken, not the first refused |
